items.desc_en: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.
items.desc_zh: 56 岁的 Hansard 凭借 2007 年低成本音乐电影《Once》获得奥斯卡最佳歌曲奖。

items.title_en: Thousands in Spain return home but new heatwave raises wildfire fears
items.title_zh: 西班牙数千人返回家园，但新的热浪引发野火担忧
items.desc_en: Spain and France are both braced for the start of the fourth heatwave so far this summer and some fires have continued to burn.
items.desc_zh: 西班牙和法国都准备迎接今年夏天迄今为止的第四次热浪，一些火灾仍在继续燃烧。

items.title_en: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
items.title_zh: 日本发生100多次余震，造成13人死亡
items.desc_en: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say
items.desc_zh: 官员称，地震余震可能达到7级，敦促人们保持警惕

items.title_en: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with facilitating terrorism
items.title_zh: 俄罗斯指控 Telegram 创始人杜罗夫协助恐怖主义
items.desc_en: The FSB claims the messenger app, created by Pavel Durov, has failed to remove accounts and channels used for recruitment by Ukraine's secret service.
items.desc_zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局声称，帕维尔·杜罗夫（Pavel Durov）创建的这款通讯应用程序未能删除乌克兰特勤局用于招募人员的帐户和渠道。

items.title_en: Data centres could pay hundreds of millions in deposits for power demands

items.desc_en: The regulator said a fee of between £237,500 to £712,500 per megawatt should be charged for upcoming projects.
items.desc_zh: 监管机构表示，即将开展的项目应收取每兆瓦 237,500 英镑至 712,500 英镑的费用。

items.title_en: 'Delulu', 'Clock it': 'Cockroach' protest brings Gen Z slang to India's parliament

items.desc_en: From "delulu" to "FOMO", Gen Z slang has made an unlikely journey from Instagram to parliament.
items.desc_zh: 从“delulu”到“FOMO”，Z 世代俚语从 Instagram 到议会进行了一次意想不到的旅程。

items.title_en: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct
items.title_zh: 四名女性指控杰瑞德·莱托性犯罪行为
items.desc_en: The actor and musician faces allegations from 10 women in total who say he mistreated them as teenagers.
items.desc_zh: 这位演员兼音乐家面临总共 10 名女性的指控，这些女性称他在青少年时期虐待过她们。

items.title_en: Brits urged to avoid dangerous plug adaptors this summer - what to watch out for

items.desc_en: Campaign group Electrical Safety First has urged those "heading abroad this summer to think before they buy".
items.desc_zh: 活动组织“电气安全第一”敦促那些“今年夏天出国的人在购买之前要三思”。
